integrity: The finite incidence automorphism group and intrinsic four-triangle partition are verified by exhaustive enumeration. The projective order and descent are taken from the published complete automorphism theorem for the associated Halphen surface; the proof explicitly links projective stabilizers of the conic set to surface automorphisms.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to nondegenerate complex Chilean configurations in the Hesse-type index-two Halphen family. It does not cover degenerate specializations, arbitrary birational self-maps, or automorphisms of the complement as an abstract variety.
title: The Chilean conic configuration has a \(24\)-fold combinatorial–projective symmetry gap
